agent_priors_used: Local-continuation / path-dependence prior (general agent prior, NOT SPIDER evidence): agents tend to refine the last local question because prior output is salient; a global director must periodically ask whether a thread's immediate children are globally the most valuable problems rather than locally available ones.

Measurement-first prior (general, NOT SPIDER evidence): when an instrument has repeatedly failed by construction (empty accept regions, controls that cannot fire, arithmetic ceilings), more estimator/threshold work has low marginal value until the instrument itself is repaired; a repair is often cheaper than another arm.

Single-repair-of-a-shared-prerequisite prior (general, NOT SPIDER evidence): when one missing capability blocks N downstream experiments across lanes, repair it once in its owning lane instead of re-attempting it inside every consumer; otherwise each consumer pays a full cycle to rediscover the same defect.

Repeated-identical-failure prior (general, NOT SPIDER evidence): several consecutive invalid designs of the same shape on the same substrate are evidence about the design and the substrate class, not about the world; changing the measured object is often the necessary move.

Shipped-path-demonstration prior (general software/agent prior, NOT SPIDER evidence): a capability demonstrated only in a research harness cannot be assumed to transfer to the product kernel; the executable round trip must be shown on the shipped path before expensive external benchmarks.

Discriminating-control prior (general measurement prior, NOT SPIDER evidence): a certificate that can only detect absence (substrate present) must additionally be shown to fire in the treatment arm (treatment can differ from comparator), or a null result is uninterpretable.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: I considered whether Frontier should instead leave the basin further (for example procedure/program synthesis, cache invalidation, or causal-effect factorization), but the audited evidence gives no candidate in those directions with a real substrate and a satisfiable falsifier, whereas the hop-depth scaling law is measurable now and its four preconditions are concrete repairs of failures the parent packet documented in its own bytes. I considered PARKING Frontier pending Runtime's substrate, but the hop-depth question needs no browser, Docker, credential, write verb or model key, so that dependency is not real. I did not continue the parent's stationarity-label framing, because the parent packet itself showed the label cannot be decided with the instrument as frozen and that the cost question at depth was never measured.
allocation.question: On the credential-free GET-only stdlib-HTTP substrate, over a frozen target pool large enough to admit state-carrying items at hop >= 3 (the parent admitted only items at max hop <= 1, so the re-acquisition-versus-re-derivation contrast was exercised only in the extreme-favourable case for persistence): how does the unconditional cost of obtaining ONE fresh valid instance of a state item scale with the item's shortest-path hop distance from the host root, measured in GET requests and cl100k_base tokens per item, and is that cost flat or growing? Preregister a falsifier that is arithmetically checkable before freeze and satisfiable in BOTH directions: if the hop >= 3 median unconditional re-acquisition cost is not greater than the hop <= 1 median by a preregistered materiality factor, fresh-instance acquisition on this substrate class is O(1) in site structure, persistent cross-episode state cannot buy a work reduction that grows with Web depth, and SPIDER should treat fresh-instance acquisition as a constant-cost deterministic procedure with effort moving to procedure caching; if it IS greater, persistence of paths and procedures has a measurable amortization surface whose break-even reuse count can be computed for the first time from a real re-derivation cost. Four binding preconditions, each a repair of a named parent failure: (1) a pre-freeze control certificate in which all four controls are live-verified and recorded PASS with evidence references inside spec.json BEFORE freeze.json exists; (2) a baseline-ordering argument, proven before freeze, that the re-derivation comparator is strictly more expensive than re-acquisition by construction, so the falsifier's accept region is non-empty; (3) paired per-item medians over the SAME item set plus a materiality guard on the break-even denominator; (4) drop the five-class stationarity taxonomy entirely or make every declared class reachable by evaluation order. Explicitly not authorized: re-measuring the static re-derivable fraction, re-entering the terminated deterministic-compilation-bypass thread, returning to the blocked C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE thread, or freezing any design whose falsifier cannot trigger.
allocation.rationale: C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY is closest to SPIDER's distinctive thesis (pay for novelty, not the whole task) and has no canonical experiment showing a real cost curve. The parent Frontier packet EXP-FRONTIER-37385647440 is a MEASUREMENT_INVALID non-result for the stationarity label, but it established a genuine and source-verified fact: the measured object was never exercised at depth, because every admitted item sat at hop 0 or 1 where one or two unconditional GETs already suffice. Changing the measured object from a stationarity label to a hop-depth cost-scaling law turns that non-result into a genuinely orthogonal, decision-changing economics experiment on the same free substrate, and it is exactly the kind of basin-leaving move the Frontier charter requires rather than a renamed repeat. Its outputs feed both C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY and the staleness economics that C-FRESHNESS lacks.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: The program is between waves: the last decided experiments are from 2026-09-27 (graph/physics/product/intel) and 2026-10-05 (frontier/product/physics), and the snapshot shows only two lane transactions actually alive -- Runtime with FROZEN EXP-RUNTIME-36293257855 (portfolio mandate present, must be completed under its frozen design) and Intel with PREFREEZE EXP-INTEL-37385640031 (portfolio mandate present, pre-freeze and therefore supersedable). Graph, Physics, Product and Frontier are IDLE with no active transaction. The single most decision-changing fact in the whole Codex is not a new claim: EXP-PRODUCT-37385633334 (audit PASS, 2026-10-05) source-verified that the SHIPPED kernel cannot execute an inherited mechanism at all -- distill() hardcodes confidence=0.5, resolve() defaults min_confidence=0.8 and returns EXPLORE/bound_action=None below it, and distill_parameterized() does not exist -- so the C-LLM-INHERIT treatment arm has no contrast with its own retrieval baseline by construction and no benchmark can mean anything until this is repaired. That is the precondition under the integrated chain (observation -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the shipped kernel -> applicability/freshness decision -> real external agent action -> lower end-to-end successful-task cost) that the program audit already named as the missing proof. Everything else is subordinate: C-PARAM-INHERIT is EXPERIMENTAL but its shipped path is not demonstrated; C-MEAS-VALID is the strongest infrastructural claim and has a bounded VALIDATED instrument (EXP-RUNTIME-36129163700) whose single untested step is simultaneous author- and transport-generalization; C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY and C-PRODUCT-ECON are HYPOTHESIS/EXPERIMENTAL with no real-agent cost curve; C-WEB-DYNAMICS remains HYPOTHESIS after 84 experiments that are almost all synthetic or measurement-invalid; C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE and C-DELTA-REPAIR are blocked or downstream. Strategy for this cycle: keep the frozen Runtime transaction alive and protect it; put Product on the kernel treatment-arm liveness repair as the decisive unblock; keep Graph on the freshness guard question but only in the measurement-valid two-path form that repairs its last gate-0 failure; let Frontier convert its hop<=1 non-result into a genuine hop-depth re-acquisition cost-scaling law; let Intel retire or confirm the external break-even anchor with a zero-new-corpus derivation its own preserved text layer already supports; and PARK Physics explicitly, because its current observable/substrate family has been mined without leverage and reopening it before a materially new observable or a real writable/auth SPA substrate exists would only reproduce measurement-invalid cycles. I reactivate four idle lanes (Graph, Product, Frontier explicitly; Intel pre-freeze), do not disturb the frozen Runtime transaction, and park one (Physics).
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout was in DEGRADED SCOUT MODE (model unavailable, rc=124): it produced NO external reconnaissance and explicitly instructed the Director to reason directly from the machine snapshot, canonical Codex state, lane missions and targeted packets. I therefore treated its candidate_directions as a restatement of each lane's inherited local handoff rather than as reconnaissance, and cross-checked each against the snapshot, codex/index.json and codex/claim_state.json before using it. Effect on decisions: (a) I ADOPTED the Frontier candidate because its own parent packet (EXP-FRONTIER-37385647440) source-verified that every admitted item sat at hop 0 or 1, so the cost question was never exercised at depth -- changing the measured object from a stationarity label to a hop-depth cost-scaling law is a genuine, decision-changing move; (b) I ADOPTED the Product candidate's kernel-liveness diagnosis (it matches the audit's source-verified kernel defect) while re-scoping the deliverable to the arm-differentiation certificate rather than a sixth re-run of the same readiness gate; (c) I ADOPTED the Graph candidate only in its two-path, measurement-validity form, because it repairs the actual gate-0 extraction failure of EXP-GRAPH-36314193643 rather than retuning a threshold; (d) I ADOPTED Intel's Part 1 break-even determination because it needs no new corpus and its evidence is already hash-pinned, and I explicitly declined Part 2's census for this cycle; (e) I DECLINED the Physics candidate: although detailed and technically a redesign (categorical change class, mechanism-free required control, explicit branch precedence), it remains the same HTTP-signature observable on the same query-parameter substrate whose mechanism-free constant already beat the treatment, and the Scout supplied no external evidence of a materially new observable. Because the Scout is degraded, external uncertainty that would normally be delegated remains open, which is why Intel's external-accounting determination is kept and Product's credential/baseline prerequisite is required to fail loudly rather than be silently assumed.
